svg.aria-label: High level architecture of the Henkel order-to-cash case, in the Data With Baraa layout. Sources: Henkel's SAP extract as two SQL files in 01_bronze, 89 rows in 15 tables. Data Warehouse on DuckDB, five layers left to right. Bronze: 15 raw tables loaded as-is by setup.py into a new database file, no checks. Silver: 18 tables, plain-word names, duplicates removed, keys enforced, per-line totals, 21 checks. Gold: 9 flat tables with the business rules, open to ship and bill, days late, overdue and to pay, 12 checks. Semantic: star schema of 3 facts and 7 dimensions, 3 checks. Analytical: 12 views, KPIs per currency in Sales, Operations and Finance marts plus a shared currency list, 7 checks. Python orchestrates the pipeline: setup.py builds Bronze, run_sql.py builds Silver to Analytical with full loads and runs the checks; folders 01_bronze to 05_analytical, report in 06_reporting. Consume: a Power BI report with 5 pages, Home, O2C Overview, Finance, Sales and Operations, that reads the 12 mart views, and ad-hoc SQL on the marts. 43 quality checks in total.
svg.title: Henkel order-to-cash high level architecture

g.text: Python orchestrates and runs the pipeline
setup.py builds the Bronze layer from the two SQL files; run_sql.py builds Silver to Analytical in order and runs the 43 checks after each layer (one bad row stops the run).
